verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Bolna sandbox or test environment, test-mode API keys, or isolation from production data. The 'Try it' API runner sends real requests to the production endpoint (api.bolna.ai), so it is not sandbox isolation. Self-hosting with Docker or Kubernetes and the Web Call SDK are adjacent deployment and testing options, not a provided sandbox, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
